highlights: Baseus USB 3.0 Male Cable to Micro B USB-B Male 1m (CADKLF-D0G)
Baseus USB cable, with micro USB-B male to USB-A male connectors.
It is 1 meter long and since it is USB 3.0, the data transfer speed reaches 5 Gbps, up to 10 times faster transfer than USB 2.0.
